data.title: THE QUEEN OF THE BLACK EMPIRE
data.intro: He humiliated her before the Five Families. His secretary stole her seat, demanded a million dollars, and mocked her as a nobody. Even her fiancé chose to protect the wrong woman and publicly rejected her. But what none of them knew was that the quiet woman they insulted was the youngest Mafia Commissioner in history.
